text:
tessa: quick feedback session — mobile console touch behavior + table overflow. prototype has a swipe-to-open sidebar and horizontal table overflow. figma: https://figma.com/file/wxyz7890 | worried about conflict with iOS back swipe. :thinking:

ryan: avoid stealing system back. on iOS the back gesture starts ~20px from left. options: visible grab-handle, or require a longer swipe threshold.

nisha: visible handle + aria-label is good. if keeping edge-swipe, add a two-step threshold (small initial move + velocity check) so accidental swipes don't trigger.

mike: account for safe-area-inset on notched devices: `padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left)`. also ensure handle is at least 44px touch area.

ryan: tables with many columns create horizontal overflow that hides row actions. propose column prioritization: important columns stay visible; others collapse into a details panel per row. priority: name > status > last run > runtime > tags.

nisha: accessibility: collapsed columns must be reachable via keyboard. details button needs aria-expanded and focus management; announce layout changes via a live region when switching to the mobile variant.

mike: implementation note: lazy-load details panel to avoid DOM bloat; virtualization gets easier with placeholder cells for collapsed columns.

tessa: copy suggestions: use "Open navigation" for the handle and "Show details" for collapsed rows. screen reader text: "Show details for job <name>".

ryan: gesture pseudo:
```
let startX = 0;
container.addEventListener('touchstart', e => startX = e.touches[0].clientX);
container.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
  const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - startX;
  if (startX < 24 && dx > 30) openSidebar();
})
```

mike: throttle, cancel on inner horizontal scroll, and respect nested carousels.

tessa: actions:
- ryan: implement edge-swipe with safe-area and thresholds, open PR
- nisha: write a11y acceptance criteria (aria labels, live region, keyboard flow)
- mike: implement column priority + lazy details
- design: update comps with grab-handle + condensed row layout
I'll add tasks to the sprint board and link figma. thanks :heart:

a11y-bot: checklist: focus order, aria-expanded, skip link, 44px targets.

nisha: i'll run a mobile screen reader pass after PR. ryan: pls tag me.
